title: Critical, Historical, and Miscellaneous Essays; Vol. 4 With a Memoir and Index
summary: "Critical, Historical, and Miscellaneous Essays; Vol. 4" by Thomas Babington Macaulay is a collection of essays published in 1843. Celebrated for their brilliant, lucid style and readability, the essays also drew criticism for their rigid Whig historical perspective and occasional inaccuracy.
